description: Fetch recent change_event rows. Enforces Google Ads constraints: date window within the last 30 days and LIMIT <= 10000.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID (without dashes, e.g., 1234567890)

endDate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

limit.description: Maximum number of returned items or rows. The declared bounds and default apply; use pagination for additional results.

operation.description: Optional ResourceChangeOperation filter, e.g. CREATE, UPDATE, REMOVE

resourceType.description: Optional ChangeEventResourceType filter, e.g. CAMPAIGN or AD_GROUP_AD

startDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 14 days before endDate.

name: google_ads_get_change_events

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: google ads get change events
